text:
sam: Heads-up — after yesterday's outage I skimmed the postmortem notes. Several remediations are still open and a few have slipped. Can we tighten closure velocity? My initial thinking: 2-week target for low-risk remediations, daily pulse for P0/P1 until resolved. Also: improve signal handoff when the IC rotates (we lost context during the midnight handover). Thoughts?

jess: +1 to faster closures. Suggest we have a minimal 'closure card' template and a lightweight pulse channel (maybe #incident-closures) so action owners are visible. Auto-create tasks where possible. :thumbsup:

priya: love the template idea. Recommended fields: owner, due, impact, rollback plan, signal to watch, validation steps, blocking deps. Keep it tiny so people actually fill it.

omar: +1. Also lifecycle states: triage / in-progress / awaiting-review / closed. Owners should ack assignment within 24h.

sam: Draft closure card (WIP):
```
closure owner: @owner
due: YYYY-MM-DD
priority: P0/P1/P2
signal: metric > threshold (link)
validation: how we'll confirm
next-step playbook: link
blocking-deps: list
```

lia: can infra-bot create tickets from open action items automatically? That would make tracking much easier.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-4213 for "prefix cache invalidation postmortem" and assigned to @omar. (automated) :robot_face:

jess: proposed comms cadence: day 0 incident summary in #incident-ops, day 1 postmortem draft, day 3 action assignment + closure cards, weekly remediation pulse until actions cleared. Small items target 2 weeks, medium 4 weeks, exceptions reviewed in ops.

priya: we also need a standard 'IC handoff note' pinned to the incident thread when IC rotates: 1-line summary, current owner(s), blockers, next checkpoint. That prevented a lot of context loss for us last night.

sam: Agreed. IC handoff checklist (suggested):
- 1-line summary for next IC
- live signal links (Grafana/alerts)
- pending tickets/action items
- immediate next-step and checkpoint time
- who to ping if things regress

omar: can we add a label 'closure-sla' and report it in the monthly ops metrics? e.g., % of actions closed within 2w, mean-time-to-close, reopen rate.

jess: yes — I'll surface these in the ops dashboard. Key metrics: % closed <=14d, mean time to close, % reopened, and % without owner after 48h.

priya: another ask: weekly remediation clustering retro where we group recurring failure modes and assign durable owners. Helps reduce repeat incidents.

sam: OK let's pilot this for the next 6 incidents: use the closure card, infra-bot ticketing, and a daily 10-min pulse in #incident-ops for the P0 week. Volunteers to run pilot coordination?

lia: I can coordinate the pilot, create the closure card example in the docs, and run the daily pulses for the pilot period. Will create a sample card by EOD tomorrow. :spiral_note_pad:

omar: I'll update the oncall runbook to include the IC handoff checklist and lifecycle states.

jess: I'll add the closure SLA metrics to the console dashboard and wire up alerts for actions without owners >48h.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll open a PR to the postmortem template repo with the closure card draft and ping this thread when it's ready. After pilot ends we'll reconvene and iterate. :eyes:
